findings.reason: the seam the deliverable names is not the one routing applies, so the node would land a preflight that still disagrees with routing for the §11 case; naming `budget_group.effective_block` (or "the substitution routing applies, review-exclusion rule included") in the deliverable changes what the node resolves and what its test must cover.
findings.text: the Why states routing "hands `budget.decide` the block that `budget_lift.effective_budget` returns" and the Deliverable says to resolve through that same `budget_lift.effective_budget`, but routing's substitution is `budget_group.effective_block` (`reckon/crew/routing.py:395`), which returns `reserve_block_for_group(lifted, config, group)` — `effective_budget`'s result with `bookend_reserve_pct` zeroed for a group whose every member is review-excluded (`reckon/crew/budget_group.py:180`, §11's rule). A worker implementing the named seam literally would leave that rule off the preflight path, so a lift-free, all-review-excluded group would read as holding the bookend reserve in the picker's verdicts while routing releases it — the same class of divergence §17 was opened to close (and the done-when's "with the lift cleared, the same reading is held at the 92% ceiling" fixture cannot catch it, since a lift-free group carrying a bookend reserve is exactly what that arm expects)

findings.reason: without `reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py` in the write paths the picker keeps handing the preflight no session and a session-scoped lift never releases reserves on the picker path the section exists to fix, and without the session in the cache key the fix would serve one session's verdicts to another; the plan should add the file and state that the cache key carries the session.
findings.text: the deliverable's session clause ("If the preflight is not told the session, the picker passes the session it routes for") names no caller within its write paths: the picker's snapshot call is `_picker_budget_snapshot` (`reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:159`), reached from `_picker_inputs` (:274), which takes no session — the session lives one frame up in `dispatch_picker_selection` (:287) — and `budget_view`/`_compose_budget_report` (`reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:598`, :457) take none either, while the report is cached under `_budget_view_request_key` (:428), whose fields are project, repo, cached_only, record count and config hash and carry no session — so the clause cannot be met from `reckon/budget.py`, `reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py` and the test alone, and a session-scoped lift's release, once threaded in, would be served from cache to a session it does not cover

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the three module anchors in the Why (`_config_with_effective_budget` in `reckon/crew/routing.py`, `budget.preflight` in `reckon/budget.py`, `reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py`) all resolve at the named symbols, §10's done-when does carry the "ceiling reads 100% with all three reserves at zero" clause the section cites, and the eight `docs/evidence/archive/a-window-paces-the-lane-landed.html` anchors added to the comments by the `_document` change all resolve to elements that exist.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the done-when is measurable (codex at 95% reads not held with `effective_ceiling_pct` 100 under a global uncapped lift; held at 92 once cleared; a session lift releases one session and not another) and names its negative control, handing the preflight the configured block again so the 95% case must read held.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the control is "logged under the run directory", a durable path under the run's own directory rather than a session scratchpad or node-local temporary, and the test points the config home at a temporary directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §17 introduces no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags; the new test file is named by mechanism (`test_the_preflight_reads_the_lift.py`) and no changelog prose is carried into a symbol.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the deliverable names the wrong seam: it says the block is resolved "through the existing seam, `budget_lift.effective_budget`, by the same substitution routing applies", but the substitution routing applies is `budget_group.effective_block`, which composes `effective_budget` with `reserve_block_for_group`'s review-exclusion rule (§11); a literal reading loses §11 on the preflight path and re-creates the two-paths-disagree defect §17 exists to fix, and the picker-session clause names no caller inside the declared write scope.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §17 carries one deliverable, judge the preflight against the block a lift puts in force, inside one declared write scope (`reckon/budget.py`, `reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py`, one new test file).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §17 declares no depends-on or gates, matching every other section in this plan (`data-links=""` throughout), and its only declared relationship, the plan-level `plan-informs` to background-agent-fitness-and-dispatch-scope, is unchanged and resolves.
